## Detailed Flagship Project Portfolio
### Project 1: rerunner (AI Agent Infrastructure & Open Source)
- **Problem**: Testing AI agents is non-deterministic, slow, and expensive. Flaky external API calls, model drift, and non-reproducible multi-step agent trajectories burn API credits and cause opaque failures in CI/CD pipelines.
- **Solution**: Engineered a deterministic flight recorder, zero-cloud-cost CI replay engine (<0.05s per replay), and time-travel debugger for AI agents with a dual-mode zero-dependency JSONL & SQLite transport. Added native Model Context Protocol (MCP) recording for Claude Code & Cursor, tamper-evident SHA-256 recording chains, an official GitHub Action, and a Pytest plugin.
- **Results**: 114 unit/integration tests passing at 100%, sub-0.5ms recording overhead, and time-travel trajectory replay. Published on PyPI (v0.3.5).
- **Stack**: Python, AI Agents, Deterministic Replay, Time-Travel Debugging, Pytest Plugin, SQLite / JSONL, Open Source.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aakash1552005/rerunner
- **PyPI Package**: https://pypi.org/project/rerunner/

### Project 2: Telco Customer Churn MLOps Platform (MLOps & Production ML)
- **Problem**: ML models often fail in production due to fragmented data pipelines, inconsistent environments, manual deployments, weak lineage, and undetected drift.
- **Solution**: Engineered an end-to-end, reproducible MLOps platform: DVC data versioning, MLflow model registry, FastAPI microservice deployed on Docker/Kubernetes, Jenkins CI/CD with AWS ECR image registry, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring, and drift-triggered retraining.
- **Results**: Tuned an XGBoost churn model achieving 0.847 ROC-AUC, raising recall from 52.7% to 75.1% (+42.6% relative gain) through threshold optimization (0.3254); protected releases with a promotion gate and 87 unit tests; measured 10 ms P50 latency with 0% errors over 25K requests.
- **Stack**: Python, XGBoost, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Prometheus, Grafana, Jenkins CI/CD, DVC.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aakash1552005/telco-churn-mlops
- **Live Demo**: https://telco-churn-mlops.streamlit.app/

### Project 3: TN Government AI Scheme Assistant (Conversational AI & RAG)
- **Problem**: Government welfare information is fragmented across 37+ scheme documents and PDFs, making it difficult for citizens to quickly find relevant benefits without hallucination.
- **Solution**: Built and deployed a bilingual (English/Tamil) hybrid RAG assistant (BM25 + ChromaDB with reciprocal rank fusion) querying 37 welfare schemes with source citations. Added a pre-LLM guardrail against off-topic answers and a 6-model fallback chain.
- **Results**: 86 unit tests passing, passed all 50 queries in an evaluation benchmark (40/40 Hit@5, 0.963 MRR), and zero hallucination tolerance.
- **Stack**: FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, ChromaDB, Groq LLaMA 3.3, RAG, Vercel.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aakash1552005/TNGov-AI-Assistant
- **Live Demo**: https://tn-gov-ai-assistant.vercel.app/

### Project 4: Autonomous Data Analyst (ADA) (Multi-Agent AI & Production AutoML)
- **Problem**: Enterprise data analysis is constrained by tedious manual workflows — diagnosing missingness, type coercion, masking sensitive PII, exploratory charting, baseline model tuning, compiling decks, and answering ad-hoc stakeholder questions without data hallucinations.
- **Solution**: Engineered a complete, production-grade 7-agent autonomous pipeline communicating via a validated Dataset Intelligence Object (DIO) for reversible cleaning, PII shielding, automated model competition, grounded insight synthesis, and interactive natural-language querying.
- **Results**: 100% verified numerical grounding, zero arbitrary code execution, automated PDF/PPTX report generation in <25 seconds, and 590 unit tests passing at 100%.
- **Stack**: Python, Multi-Agent System, AutoML (LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, Scikit-learn), Streamlit, Flask REST API, n8n Automations, ReportLab, python-pptx.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aakash1552005/Autonomous-Data-Analyst
- **Live Demo**: https://autonomous--data--analyst.streamlit.app/
